printPreflight.title: Print Preflight
printPreflight.disclaimer: This tool is a pre-print risk check and does not guarantee actual print results. Final output still depends on your print shop's specs, paper stock, ICC profile, CMYK conversion, and proofing.

upload.title: Upload AI Image
upload.hint: PNG, JPG, WebP. Assess poster/card/canvas output risk before sending to print.

settings.title: Output Settings
settings.fineDetail: Image contains small text or thin lines

preview.empty: Upload an image to see the preview and score here
preview.simHint: Estimated at ~96 screen DPI; drag to pan

hint.good: Resolution is sufficient — safe to print at this size.
hint.warning: Resolution is on the low side; it will look soft up close. Upscale first (e.g. Upscayl) or reduce the output size.
hint.bad: Not enough resolution — the print will be visibly blurry. Use a higher-resolution image or print much smaller.

hint.good: Details are crisp and will hold up at print size.
hint.warning: Overall soft; check whether the source was upscaled, or regenerate at higher resolution.
hint.bad: Visibly blurry — printing will make it worse. Regenerate or replace the image.

hint.good: Noise and compression artifacts are minimal — good to print.
hint.warning: Visible noise or JPEG artifacts; use the original PNG or denoise first.
hint.bad: Heavy noise/compression artifacts will show as grain or banding in print. Use an uncompressed original.

hint.good: Few highly saturated colors — low risk of visible color shift.
hint.warning: Contains neon-like saturated colors that will print duller than on screen. Proof critical colors with your print shop.
hint.bad: Large areas of highly saturated color (neon blue/purple/green) will turn muddy in CMYK. Adjust the palette or accept the shift.

report.title: Check Report
report.desc: Download a data summary you can hand to your print shop, including effective DPI, printable size, risk items, and suggested next steps.

reportText.header: === AI Image Print Preflight Report (browser estimate) ===
reportText.footer: Note: this report is a browser-side estimate and does not cover ICC profiles, CMYK conversion, or paper stock. Confirm with a proof from your print shop.
reportText.inquiry: Hi, I'd like to print an image at {{w}} x {{h}} mm ({{bleed}}mm bleed). The file is {{pxW}} x {{pxH}} px PNG/JPG, roughly {{dpi}} DPI at that size. Is this resolution OK to print, and do I need to adjust anything or add bleed?
